speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming your chronic joint pain. To better understand your condition, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and which specific joints are most affected?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis (likely with secondary gout given the involvement of the left great toe).

I would like to confirm your history of gout or kidney stones, and I request a set of X-Rays for your hip, knee, and left great toe to assess for joint space narrowing and erosions. REQUEST IMAGES: Hip_Knee_Toe_XRays.
